fact: The Mauritius National Identity Card Unit's page lists the National Identity Card Act, No. 60 of 1985 (an Act of Parliament) as the law behind the identity card system, with the new MNIC 3.0 card operational since 19 February 2024; the page is dated 2024-02-19 and gives no other date for the state of the law.
system: National Identity Card Act, No. 60 of 1985

fact: Government Notice No. 29 of 2024, the National Identity Card Regulations 2024, were made by the Minister under section 10 of the National Identity Card Act, which they apply, and came into operation on 19 February 2024; the regulations are subsidiary legislation, and the Act is an Act of Parliament.

The National Identity Card Regulations 2024 (Government Notice No. 29 of 2024), made by the Minister on 16 February 2024 under section 10 of the National Identity Card Act, set the new identity card, its digital seal and fingerprint-based application, and revoke the National Identity Card Regulations 2013.

The National Identity Card Regulations 2024, made under section 10 of the National Identity Card Act, set an identity card with a digital seal applied for with fingerprints, so the Act in force provides for a biometric, electronically checkable identity.
